name: Diva Beauty Lounge
tagline:
Nails that last.
Care you feel.
about: A nail and beauty lounge on Blenheim Boulevard in Fairfax City. Clients praise the Russian manicures that stay perfect for weeks, detailed brow and lash work, and a genuinely kind team.

reviews.author: Christie B.
reviews.text: Everyone has been so kind and talented. The level of attention and detail is unlike any salon I’ve ever been to.

reviews.author: Meri P.
reviews.text: They do amazing Russian manicure and pedicure, creating very thin, natural-looking nails with long-lasting results and no lifting.

reviews.author: Madison M.
reviews.text: My coworker recommended this place about a year ago and I drive all the way from DC to go here! It is so worth it though.
